pages.text: Nested shells around a star, each running on the waste heat of the one inside. Computation is limited by Landauer: erasing a bit costs kT·ln2, so the cold outer shell sets the price - and the coolant sets how cold it can be.
$(thing)Set$(): Inner shell radius, Number of shells, Duty.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Stellar luminosity variation: the inner shell runs at T·(1 ± 1%·d).
$(thing)Limits$(): The inner shell is melting; The core is overheating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Computation rate follows the usable power.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Inner shell temperature: T₁ = 278.6 K/√(r/AU)$(br)Outer shell temperature: T_out = max(T_coolant, T₁e^(−N/2))$(br)Carnot efficiency: η = 1 − T_out/T₁$(br)Bit operations: N = ηL/(kT·ln2)
